The inventory summarizes modeled soil carbon, aboveground biomass, and annualized nitrous-oxide fluxes for California crop fields from January 2016 through December 2023. The analysis was stratified by annual crops and woody perennial crops from site selection through model fitting and downscaling.

## Inventory summary

| Outcome | Annual crops | Woody perennial crops | Unit and basis |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Soil carbon | 113.22 (17.42) | 87.93 (16.56) | Tg C, December 2023 stock |
| Aboveground biomass | 4.64 (5.91) | 1,147.70 (314.60) | Gg C, December 2023 stock |
| N~2~O-N | 9.25 (8.28) | 9.06 (7.99) | Gg N yr^-1^, annualized December 2023 flux |

: Ensemble mean with standard deviation in parentheses. {#tbl-inventory-summary}

Mean soil-carbon change from January 2016 to December 2023 was -18.66 Tg C for annual crops and -18.50 Tg C for woody perennial crops, or -37.16 Tg C across both crop classes.

## Spatial context

![California annual-crop and woody-perennial fields included in the downscaling analysis.](assets/carb-results/inventory-spatial-context.webp){#fig-inventory-context .lightbox fig-alt="Map of California showing annual-crop and woody-perennial field locations included in the downscaling analysis"}

## Soil carbon

### County stocks

![December 2023 county soil-carbon stocks for annual crops and woody perennial crops.](assets/carb-results/inventory-soc-county.webp){#fig-inventory-soc-county .lightbox fig-alt="Paired California county maps showing December 2023 soil-carbon stocks for annual and woody perennial crops"}

The largest county stocks occur where agricultural area coincides with moderate or high modeled stock density.

### Field density

![December 2023 field soil-carbon density for annual crops and woody perennial crops.](assets/carb-results/inventory-soc-field.webp){#fig-inventory-soc-field .lightbox fig-alt="Paired California field maps showing December 2023 soil-carbon density for annual and woody perennial crops"}

Field density reveals spatial variation within counties. Northern and coastal agricultural regions generally show higher modeled density than many southern and interior fields.

### Change, 2016–2023

![County soil-carbon stock change from January 2016 to December 2023 for annual crops and woody perennial crops. Negative values indicate stock loss.](assets/carb-results/inventory-soc-change.webp){#fig-inventory-soc-change .lightbox fig-alt="Paired California county maps showing soil-carbon stock changes between January 2016 and December 2023"}

Modeled soil-carbon stocks decline across much of the inventory area. These values are endpoint stock differences in Gg C.

## Nitrous oxide

![December 2023 annualized N~2~O-N flux by county for annual crops and woody perennial crops.](assets/carb-results/inventory-n2o-county.webp){#fig-inventory-n2o-county .lightbox fig-alt="Paired California county maps showing December 2023 annualized nitrous-oxide nitrogen fluxes for annual and woody perennial crops"}

Annual and woody perennial crops have similar statewide ensemble-mean N~2~O-N fluxes, with different spatial distributions. Values are reported as annualized native nitrogen fluxes at the December 2023 endpoint.

## Aboveground biomass

### County stocks

![December 2023 county aboveground-biomass stocks for annual crops and woody perennial crops.](assets/carb-results/inventory-biomass-county.webp){#fig-inventory-biomass-county .lightbox fig-alt="Paired California county maps showing December 2023 aboveground-biomass stocks for annual and woody perennial crops"}

Woody perennial biomass is concentrated in the Central Valley and other orchard-producing regions.

### Field density

![December 2023 field aboveground-biomass density for annual crops and woody perennial crops.](assets/carb-results/inventory-biomass-field.webp){#fig-inventory-biomass-field .lightbox fig-alt="Paired California field maps showing December 2023 aboveground-biomass density for annual and woody perennial crops"}

Woody perennial fields have higher modeled biomass density than annual-crop fields across most regions.

### Change, 2016–2023

![County aboveground-biomass stock change from January 2016 to December 2023.](assets/carb-results/inventory-biomass-change.webp){#fig-inventory-biomass-change .lightbox fig-alt="Paired California county maps showing aboveground-biomass stock changes between January 2016 and December 2023"}

Modeled aboveground biomass declines over much of the inventory period, particularly for woody perennial crops in parts of the Central Valley.
